title: Policy gateway
description: The policy gateway's stack data (X1 item G1; body B4): the action kinds every action passes before it runs, each with its hook sites (the functions that call gateway.check with that kind; `gateway.py lint` fails a kind with no hook), and the evaluators a policy can be judged by (a subprocess fed one JSON request on stdin, answering one JSON object on stdout). The owner's modes and policies are in gateway-policy.json. A boundary path: no role writes it.

decision_event.description: The type of the one trusted event line written per decision (mode audit or enforce).

default_timeout_s.description: Seconds an evaluator may take when its entry names no timeout_s; past it the decision is an evaluator failure.

logged_string_max.description: Characters of one string input a decision line shows; a longer one is logged as {sha256, length} (the evaluator still gets it whole).

target.description: JSON pointer into the action's inputs: the action's target ({target} of an evaluator request; empty when the inputs have no string there).

hooks.description: Where the kind is checked: each a function (in a file relative to the stack) that calls gateway.check with this kind (a literal, or a kind read from data). The lint fails a kind with none.

argv.description: The command, never a shell string; {stack} is the stack folder.

request.description: The JSON written to the evaluator's stdin: a template. A string that is exactly one placeholder becomes its value (typed); other {name} placeholders are filled as text. Names: kind, role, project, run, card, adapter, target, inputs (the action's inputs, unmasked), policies (the owner policies covering the kind: [{id, text}]), stack.

verdict.description: JSON pointer to the decision in the answer: "allow" allows, "deny" denies, anything else is a bad answer.

reason.description: JSON pointer to a reason text in the answer (absent: none given).

status.description: Only an approved evaluator decides; naming one that is off refuses.
